item.title: Fathom Realty appoints Stephanie Verderose as VP of growth
item.description: Verderose will report to Lori Muller, president of Fathom Realty — leading initiatives to expand agent productivity and strengthen culture.

item.title: Mutual of Omaha to sponsor reverse mortgage broker certification program
item.description: The National Association of Mortgage Brokers (NAMB) announced Tuesday that leading reverse lender Mutual of Omaha Mortgage is partnering with the trade group as the exclusive sponsor for a reverse mortgage specialist certification program.

item.description: United Real Estate is reigniting acquisitions and leveraging scale for margin recovery, says CEO Dan Duffy.

item.title: Property tax burdens vary widely as states debate senior relief
item.description: As states debate relief, the underlying data shows a common trend: residential property owners shouldering a growing share of the tax burden.

item.description: Union Home Mortgage has shown a strong appetite for mergers and acquisitions by hiring Renee Hildebrand from Guild Mortgage to seek new opportunities, the company announced Tuesday.
